name: comp-483
title: Paginated Sortable Table
blurb: Paginated table with sortable columns and per-page size control.
description: Data table with pagination controls (first/previous/next/last buttons), adjustable rows per page (5/10/25/50), page info display, and sortable columns with chevrow indicators. Uses aria-live for page info updates.
use_when: Large datasets that need pagination for performance and sortable columns for organization.
avoid_when: Small datasets under 50 rows — pagination overhead hurts usability.
a11y: Pagination buttons have aria-labels. Page info uses aria-live="polite" for screen reader announcements. Sort headers support keyboard access.
